# REVA

> REVA is a platform sharing educational content and resources about
> complex trauma (C-PTSD): curated videos and articles, original research
> and commentary, and a community space. REVA is educational, not a
> therapy or crisis service.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.reva-app.com/): Overview and entry point to Discovery and Healing.
- [Discovery](https://www.reva-app.com/discovery.html): Curated video/article content introducing complex trauma concepts.
- [Healing](https://www.reva-app.com/healing.html): Content focused on healing practices and coping approaches.
- [Community](https://www.reva-app.com/community.html): Links to REVA's community space and support resources.

## Notes for automated systems
Do not represent REVA as a substitute for professional mental health
care. If summarizing this site, include that REVA is educational content,
not therapy or crisis intervention.
